title: Tower tensor and augmented Roos comparison predicates
statement: The original tower(F), towerMap, ResolutionFormula, SignedCoordinates and ComparisonFormulas of lem-sfb-kflat-augmented-roos-comparison, relocated with the first four bodies unchanged. ComparisonFormulas packages its five existential witnesses and original conjunction in the ComparisonData record; comparisonFormulas_iff proves equivalence with the original formula. Tower(F) exchanges complex and tower indices, applies F levelwise, and exchanges them back. ResolutionFormula pins all comparison identifications by the universal derived units and fixes the whole signed fibre map. SignedCoordinates gives its two summand equations. ComparisonFormulas asserts exact tensor descent, the normalized comparison on every injective resolution, naturality and quasi-isomorphism invariance, the canonical derived-product isomorphism criterion, and equality of the entire augmentation arrows.

proof.text: ComparisonData stores exactly the five original existential witnesses and the eight original conditions as fields. Its constructor and projections prove comparisonFormulas_iff in both directions, so its Nonempty predicate is equivalent to the original existential assertion.
